name: foodies-directory
description: Phone-friendly food directory kept in a Google Sheet, with a Google Apps Script backend

scripts.push-prod: cd apps-script && copy /Y .clasp-prod.json .clasp.json && npx clasp push -f
scripts.pull-prod: cd apps-script && copy /Y .clasp-prod.json .clasp.json && npx clasp pull
scripts.push-test: cd apps-script && copy /Y .clasp-test.json .clasp.json && npx clasp push -f
scripts.pull-test: cd apps-script && copy /Y .clasp-test.json .clasp.json && npx clasp pull
